The '''Cloud City Central Bank''' was a [[Bank/Legends|bank]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. It handled the auction bids of the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
